policy_rules: Every expected reason code must appear in observed_reason_codes.
Any absent expected reason code must be reported in missing_required_reason_codes.
Every observed code must be either expected or explicitly allowed as an extra.
A case fails when missing_required_reason_codes is non-empty.
A case fails when unexpected_extra_reason_codes is non-empty.
Dominant reason-code precedence remains governed by the priority-table path already added in v7.
